race.title: Killowen Contracts Handicap
race.verdict: An ultra-competitive sprint in which it could pay to side with GO ATHLETICO , who is clearly not the force of old but fared better dropped in grade when runner-up in a C&D claimer under this rider earlier in the month. Back in a handicap, he can get the better of My Cubby Bear , who failed to build on her return but is one of the least exposed. Stable-switcher Saint Acclaim and Thaloria are another couple to consider, as well. GO ATHLETICO (FR) MY CUBBY BEAR (IRE) SAINT ACCLAIM (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: My Cubby Bear (7/2), Go Athletico (6/1), Carrigans Grove (7/1), Saint Acclaim (7/1), Alfred Tennyson (8/1), Blue Anthem (8/1), Andaman Fifty (8/1), I'm Spartacus (10/1), Thaloria (12/1), Mint Man (16/1), Sovereign Cry (16/1), Leonie (25/1), Dandyville (33/1), All Hail (33/1)
